changelog:
🚀 JARVIS AI v1.8.7 Update!

🛠️ KYA FIX HUA (BUG FIXES):
• 📱 Zero-App-Interruption Background Mode: 'Go to background' bolne par ab background me chal rahi dusri apps (YouTube, Chrome, WhatsApp) band nahi hongi, JARVIS smoothly silent standby mode me switch karega bina kisi open app ko close kiye.
• 🎯 Clean Navigation Gesture Separation: 'Go to home' aur 'Go to background' commands ko alag kiya gaya taaki background mode trigger hone par launcher screen par na le jaye.
